title: How to use the e-book reader
description: Try turning pages, jumping to chapters, changing the reading display and saving your place in this short practice edition.

chapters.title: Turn a page
paragraphs: Tap the highlighted arrow on the right edge to move forward. The left edge takes you back.
You can also use the keyboard arrow keys or the Previous and Next buttons in the footer. Continue to the next chapter to try Contents.
chapters.diagramAlt: Reader diagram. Previous is on the left edge and Next is on the right edge.

chapters.title: Jump to a chapter
paragraphs: Choose the highlighted Contents icon in the top bar. Select “Make the page your own” to jump directly to that chapter.
Try reopening Contents and choosing “Turn a page” to go back.
chapters.diagramAlt: Reader toolbar diagram. Contents is the first icon in the top-right group, shown as three horizontal lines.

chapters.title: Make the page your own
paragraphs: Open the highlighted Settings gear. Choose a font, increase the text size and try the Warm page colour.
Use the expand icon to enter or leave fullscreen. Choose “Save your place” in Contents when you are ready.
chapters.diagramAlt: Reader toolbar diagram. Settings is the gear beside Contents. Fullscreen is the expand icon near Close.

chapters.title: Save your place
paragraphs: Open Settings. Tick “Remember my place on this device” below Page colour, then close and reopen this practice e-book to test it.
Untick it to clear the saved position. To save a whole entry instead, use its bookmark and open the Library’s Reading list.
chapters.diagramAlt: Settings diagram. The “Remember my place on this device” checkbox sits below Page colour.
